name: Project roles and permissions
summary: What a user may do in a project: system and custom roles, permission strings, how direct and group roles combine, and who may change roles.

roles.note: The confirmed rule is that permissions, not titles, decide (USER-REQ-029). This matrix shows what the seed roles hold. A custom role with the same permission strings gets the same rights.

nfr.statement: Added latency of the permission check on each API request.

nfr.statement: How quickly a role change takes effect on every API.
nfr.open_question: Is a delay acceptable after a role is changed or removed, and how long? Permissions are cached (T3D-RULE-023).

requirements.title: Project actions need a verified user with the right permission
requirements.statement: To act in a project, a user must be verified and hold a role there that grants the permission for that action. Roles are assigned manually.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A verified user whose project role lacks create-asset
acceptance_criteria.when: They try to create a progress asset in that project

requirements.title: Before any project assignment, a user can manage only their own profile
requirements.statement: An ordinary verified user with no project assignment can only manage their own profile. Company-wide super-admin authority, if separately granted, is a different rule (USER-REQ-038).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A verified user with no project assignment and no company authority
acceptance_criteria.when: They try to edit their profile, and separately to view or manage any project
acceptance_criteria.then: Profile editing works, and every project action is denied

requirements.title: Effective permissions combine the direct role and all group roles
requirements.statement: A user's permissions on a project are the union of their direct role and every role they get through groups on that project. With no assignment, they have none.

acceptance_criteria.given: A viewer on project P who is also in a group that grants collaborator on P
acceptance_criteria.when: They try to create an asset in P
acceptance_criteria.then: It is allowed, because collaborator grants create-asset

requirements.title: Three system roles, plus custom roles per project
requirements.statement: Every project has three system roles: admin (all project permissions), collaborator (read plus limited write) and viewer (read only). Users with the permission can add custom roles scoped to one project, with any subset of project permissions.

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

acceptance_criteria.given: A new permission string is added to the catalog
acceptance_criteria.then: The admin system role gains it

requirements.title: Custom roles always include the default permissions
requirements.statement: A custom role can't use a reserved name (admin, collaborator, viewer) or the name of another role in the same project. When saved, it also receives every permission in the Default group, even ones the creator didn't select.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user creates a custom role and selects only view-asset
acceptance_criteria.then: It holds view-asset plus view-zones, view-project and visual-documentation

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with a custom role named Site lead
acceptance_criteria.when: Someone creates another role named Site lead, or one named viewer

requirements.title: Create custom roles and assign them
requirements.statement: Users with role-management permission can create custom roles from selected permissions and assign them to people. Assigned users can then use only the features their role permits.
requirements.rationale: The PRD says "administrators". The confirmed rule makes this permission-based (USER-REQ-029). Saved roles also receive the default permissions (USER-REQ-024).

requirements.title: System roles can't be changed, only cloned
requirements.statement: The default system roles can't be edited or deleted. They can be cloned into a custom role, which can then be changed.

requirements.title: Import roles from another project
requirements.statement: A user can import custom roles from another project where they have admin access.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user is admin on project Q, which has a custom role Inspector
acceptance_criteria.when: They import roles from Q into project P
acceptance_criteria.then: Inspector appears in P's roles list

requirements.title: Inviting users and changing roles is permission-based
requirements.statement: Any user assigned to a project may invite users and change their project roles if they hold the relevant permissions. An admin title alone neither grants nor is required for this. The limit on which roles they may grant is not decided (DEC-013).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A collaborator whose custom role includes update-project-user and assign-project-user
acceptance_criteria.when: They invite a user and change another user's role
acceptance_criteria.then: Both actions are allowed, even though they are not an admin

requirements.title: Anyone with update-project-user can grant any project role
requirements.statement: In the web app, changing a project user's role requires update-project-user on that project. There is no limit on which role may be granted, so a holder can make someone (including, unverified, themselves) an admin. Users who hold super-admin or regional-admin can't have their project role changed this way.
